# Decision Memo: Vendor Selection — Year One

**To:** CFO
**From:** Priya, Procurement
**Re:** Vendor recommendation for platform procurement

## Summary

Recommend **Vendor Alpha**. Vendor Beta fails the mandatory SSO constraint and cannot go to production.

## Evaluation Against Constraints

| Constraint | Alpha | Beta |
|---|---|---|
| Year-one budget ≤ $100,000 | ✅ $92,000 | ✅ $70,000 |
| SSO mandatory before production | ✅ Available | ❌ Unavailable; no committed date |
| Other stated requirements | ✅ Met | ✅ Met |

## Analysis

Beta offers a $22,000 cost advantage, but this is irrelevant. SSO is mandatory before production. Beta has no committed delivery date for SSO, meaning the platform cannot reach production within year one under any planned timeline. Selecting Beta introduces unlimited project delay risk and likely wasted spend.

Alpha is $8,000 under the budget ceiling, includes SSO, and meets all stated requirements.

## Recommendation

Approve Vendor Alpha at $92,000 total year-one cost. Beta is not viable given the SSO constraint.

Awaiting your sign-off to proceed.
